QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Alliance Fleet Descent Operation
QuestInfo.0: The ZDF space fleet is ready to descend through the atmosphere, break through the BWZ barrier, and deploy the ultimate weapon in the heart of Tokyo to resolve this. Return to #m802000101# for now, and guard the Old Firefox flagship, which carries the ultimate weapon.
QuestInfo.1: The descending Alliance fleet face the Mechanized Maverick Platoon in the skies above Tokyo. Cover the Old Firefox flagship by shooting down as many of the enemy as possible. Be warned, the enemy warship #o9601832# is on its way.
QuestInfo.2: You fought off the Mechanized Maverick Platoon, but now the #o9601832# warship has arrived. Destroy it and clear the path to the landing zone.
